I am an old woman, 57 years, and I work this small piece of land alone with help from my family. This plot is very small, only a little piece, and I grow what I grow every year like my mother showed me. I do not have much cash, and one bag of fertilizer is too big for this small plot and too costly for me. I will put the manure from my animals like always, and I use the seed I kept from last harvest because the improved seed from the cooperative costs money I do not have and sometimes it does not come on time anyway.

The rains here in Tigray have been hard these past seasons, and I am careful. I do not have irrigation on this plot, only what the sky gives. I will work it myself with my hands and maybe my daughter or grandchild helps me when there is much to do. I cannot pay people to come work, so I do not hire.
